scope: Exact source-replayed MCP tool descriptor JSON, ordering, descriptions and argument schemas for explicit capability profiles. A profile does not establish live host support, runtime effects, tool results, transport behavior, account gates or packaged application acceptance.
reconstruction: For each case, toolsJson = "[" + descriptorSha256.map(hash => descriptorCorpus[hash]).join(",") + "]". descriptorCorpus values are exact per-tool JSON.stringify output; JSON.parse yields the full native descriptor and inputSchema. toolsJsonSha256 binds byte order and spelling.

capabilityRules.platform: win32 changes OS/app naming descriptions; list_apps requires darwin and appScoped.
capabilityRules.coordinateMode: pixels or normalized_0_100 changes display coordinate descriptions; app tools use window-local pixel frames.
capabilityRules.screenshotFiltering: native, mask or none changes screenshot description and makes no claim beyond the supplied capability.
capabilityRules.adaptiveResolution: false removes scale from display screenshot/zoom and batch/teach item schemas; omitted means enabled.
capabilityRules.saveToDisk: false removes save_to_disk from display screenshot/zoom/batch; omitted means enabled.
capabilityRules.teachMode: truthy appends request_teach_access, teach_step, teach_batch before background tools.
capabilityRules.appScoped: truthy appends takeover and app_* tools; object.supportsRawInput truthy additionally appends app_bring_to_current_space. Omitted supportsRawInput means false.
capabilityRules.installedApps: A nonempty list is joined into request_access and request_teach_access app-field descriptions as data.
